stem.text: A non-uniform bar PQ has length $50\,\text{cm}$ and weight $200\,\text{N}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal bar labelled non-uniform bar, with end P at the left and end Q at the right. A small block sits on the top of the bar near its centre, labelled block. A vertical arrow labelled 360 N points up at end Q. A dimension line below the bar is labelled 50 cm.

stem.text: A block of weight $400\,\text{N}$ is attached to the top of the bar at its centre. The bar rests on horizontal ground.
A vertical force of $360\,\text{N}$ is now exerted upwards on the bar at end Q and is just sufficient to lift end Q from the ground.
What is the distance from the centre of gravity of the bar to end P?
